answer.report_md:
**画出来要什么**

本页两图皆无图号,只有两行标题:`Observed Malware Families by Category, 2024` + `Ransomware-Related`。上图是一个 8 格的马赛克/树状图,格子里直接排版巨号数字(34、16、12、10、10、7、6、5),`%` 以上标小字紧贴数字右上;类别名 `Ransomware`、`Credential Stealer` 用大字,窄格 `Tunneler`、`Downloader`、`Dropper` 缩成小字;蓝色由深到浅随数值递减。下图是 6 根竖柱,左侧竖排轴题 `% of Intrusions`,刻度 0/5/10/15,只有横向网格,数值标在柱顶内侧,x 轴标签上下交错两行且 `REDBIKE (Akira)` 换行。两图右侧都紧贴一列正文,图文共占一个横带。

**定位一个值难在哪**

下图 `REDBIKE (Akira)` 的 10% 与 `RANSOMHUB` 的 10% 等高,而上图 `Backdoor`、`Utility` 也都是 10%——同一页四个 10。要唯一定位必须同时带图标题、类别名,且类别名要按交错换行的原样写出。

**不确定的**

上图格子面积是否严格与百分比成比例(Tunneler 7 的格子看着比 Downloader 6 窄一线)无法确认;蓝色深浅是否只是装饰、还是编码排名,也只能猜。评分给出的第 4 个 `10` 归 Backdoor 还是 Utility 无从判断。

worked_example.why_hard: Label 'Tunneler' set in tiny type in a narrow cell; the '7' sits in the block below it
Same 10% as RANSOMHUB beside it; its tick label wraps two lines and sits on the upper stagger row

components.evidence: Two separately captioned charts: 'Observed Malware Families by Category, 2024' and 'Most Frequently Seen Malware, 2024'
Body column 'Compared to the overall metrics...' runs to the right of f1; another column beside f2
Mosaic cells carry only printed percentages; no ticks, no baseline drawn anywhere
'34', '16', '12', '10' set in large type inside their coloured blocks
'Tunneler', 'Downloader', 'Dropper' shrunk to small caps inside the narrow right-hand cells
'15%', '10%', '9%', '7%' printed just inside the top of each bar
Horizontal rules at 5, 10, 15 across the plot; no vertical rules
'% of Intrusions' set vertically along the left axis
Axis ticks read bare 0, 5, 10, 15; scale word only in '% of Intrusions'
'REDBIKE' with '(Akira)' on the line below it on the category axis

new_components.name: staggered_category_ticks
new_components.evidence: BEACON, REDBIKE, LOCKBIT on an upper row; RANSOMHUB, BASTA, SYSTEMBC dropped to a lower row

new_components.name: superscript_unit_glyph_on_value_label
new_components.evidence: '%' set as a small superscript at the top right of each giant numeral, e.g. '34' then '%'

new_components.name: sequential_shade_by_magnitude
new_components.evidence: Blue darkens with cell size: Ransomware darkest, Dropper 5% palest, with no legend

new_components.name: unnumbered_figure_heading
new_components.evidence: Neither chart carries 'Figure N'; only a bold title line plus 'Ransomware-Related'

spot_checks.mark: the Ransomware cell, the large dark-blue block on the left
the Other cell, second block from the left
the Credential Stealer cell, upper part of the third column
the Backdoor cell, directly under Credential Stealer; Utility also reads 10%, so which mark is meant is ambiguous
the RANSOMHUB bar, second from left
the REDBIKE (Akira) bar, third from left, same height as RANSOMHUB
the BASTA bar, fourth from left
the LOCKBIT bar, fifth from left, equal to BASTA
the SYSTEMBC bar, rightmost; the Tunneler cell on f1 also reads 7%

answer.hardest_step_why: 10 在本页出现四次(Backdoor、Utility、RANSOMHUB、REDBIKE),9 出现两次;树状图无坐标轴,标签只在格内,难与单元格绑定。

examples.quote: Bold line 'Observed Malware Families by Category, 2024' with 'Ransomware-Related' beneath; no 'Figure' number anywhere
examples.why: 标题拆成主副两行且无图号,现有流程只有单一 title 字段,副标题与缺号无法表达。

examples.quote: '34' set in huge type with a small superscript '%' at its top right, inside the coloured block
examples.why: 数值标签的字号随格子大小变化、单位作上标另置,当前标签渲染只有统一字号与紧跟单位。

examples.quote: 'Compared to the overall metrics, ransomware-related intrusions saw a higher percentage of BEACON usage (15%).' runs in a column right of the chart
examples.why: 图与正文共占一个横带,整页导出时正文列与图表标题的先后顺序需被记录。

examples.quote: BEACON, REDBIKE (Akira), LOCKBIT on one tick row; RANSOMHUB, BASTA, SYSTEMBC dropped to a second row below
examples.why: 需要交错(stagger)刻度标签这一布局选项;现无此项,长标签只能旋转或换行。
